name: AneRBC dataset
description: A benchmark dataset of red blood cell (RBC) images intended to support computer-aided anemia diagnosis and related classification tasks.
reputation: A domain-specific dataset used in hematology and medical-imaging research for RBC analysis and anemia-related classification tasks; modest adoption in the medical imaging community.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; likely subject to class imbalance, limited dataset size, and annotation variability — results sensitive to preprocessing and segmentation quality.
